name: ISO 27001 Certification Readiness
target_buyer: Israeli tech companies pursuing US government contracts, enterprise customers, or M&A due diligence

icp.geo: Israel / US / EU — companies with enterprise or government requirements
icp.trigger: Pursuing SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, DFARS, or enterprise sales

detection_signals: No formal ISMS (Information Security Management System)
No risk assessment in the past 12 months
No asset inventory or data classification
fix_deliverables: Risk Assessment Template (aligned to ISO 27001 Annex A)
enforcement_cases: NIST CSF required for DoD contractors (DFARS 252.204-7012)
ISO 27001 required by 60%+ of enterprise procurement teams (2024)
Israeli companies in US M&A — ISO 27001 a common LOI condition
